newsitem.title: USA: Moody's drops Springfield, Ill., rating to A1.
newsitem.headline: Moody's drops Springfield, Ill., rating to A1.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service cited problems with Springfield, Ill.'s self-insurance fund for its recent downgrade to A1 from Aa of the city's $58.7 million of outstanding debt, the rating agency reported in its Credit Perspectives publication due out Friday.
Moody's said the city's use of the fund for non-insurance related purposes that were not reimbursed and the city's aggressive investment practices to bolster the fund had resulted in losses.
"The failure to adequately monitor the fund's reserves and implement effective management controls impairs the city's overall credit quality," the rating agency wrote.

Moody' pointed out that Springfield officials have developed a plan to replenish fund reserves by restructuring and reducing over the near term debt service requirments for debt issued to capitalize the fund.

"By restructuring existing debt rather than drawing on current resources to support the recapitalization of the fund, the administration has demonstrated a limit on its willingness to tap its sizable and growing base to meet its fiscal requirements," Moody's said.
